name: flomoenhanced
description: 浮墨增强版 —— 以 flomo 快速记录体验为基础，增加模板与洞察分析（FlomoEnhanced）

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @flomo/web && npm run build -w @flomo/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @flomo/shared && npm run typecheck -w @flomo/web && npm run typecheck -w @flomo/api
scripts.test: npm run test -w @flomo/shared && npm run test -w @flomo/web && npm run test -w @flomo/api
